audio: macOS say voices Samantha, Daniel, Karen, Rishi, 16 kHz mono, 20 sentences each; babble = another voice and sentence 10 dB below the speaker
method: Each engine runs the service's own code path on every clip once: Whisper through LocalModels.transcribe (CPU int8, Silero VAD, primed with the agent names), Parakeet through ParakeetWorker (MLX on the GPU, its own process), one engine after the other. Latency is wall time per utterance after warm-up; the load average and swap in use are recorded with it.
